svg.aria-label: Sixteen source databases pass through per-source preparation scripts into derivative CSV tables; GSHP (global), the restricted EU-HYDI (Europe), the Australian CSIRO cores (NatSoil and Boorowa), Ksat-SSIR-DB (Brazil), the Yellow River Basin (China), Hohenbrink (Germany), Zanjanrood (Iran), Fujii et al. (Japan, with Indonesia and Thailand), Laikipia (Kenya), the Canary Islands and the Andalusian soils (Spain), and KSSL, Arizona and Kansas (USA) form the default merged reference of 21,876 layers, with UNSODA and sDB added only in the all set.

Also writes an unconstrained companion fit (θr, θs, α, n, m) alongside the
